sources.name: Federal Decree-Law No. 38 of 2022 (Criminal Procedure Law)

steps.title: Filing of Criminal Complaint
steps.description: A criminal complaint is filed with the police regarding an alleged offence under UAE law.

steps.title: Police Investigation
steps.description: Police investigate the complaint, collect evidence, and record statements.

steps.title: Referral to Public Prosecution
steps.description: The case file is referred to the Public Prosecution for review and further action.

steps.title: Public Prosecution Investigation
steps.description: Public Prosecution examines evidence, questions parties, and determines whether to prosecute or dismiss the case.

steps.title: Filing of Charges
steps.description: If sufficient grounds exist, Public Prosecution files charges before the competent criminal court.

steps.title: Trial
steps.description: Court conducts hearings, examines evidence, and hears arguments from the prosecution and defence.

steps.title: Judgment
steps.description: Court issues a judgment of conviction or acquittal.

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal against judgment as permitted under UAE Criminal Procedure Law
Appeal on points of law as permitted under UAE law
